Credits & licenses

This is a noncommercial research demonstration. Third-party assets retain their own licenses.

  • Sample images and annotations: CubiCasa5K, used under CC BY-NC 4.0. Images are resized and letterboxed; prediction geometry and thumbnails are derived from them. Original dataset: DOI 10.5281/zenodo.2613548. Sample source identifiers are included in each JSON output.
  • Pretrained model: NVIDIA SegFormer-B0 ADE20K checkpoint. Model license. The ONNX weights are an export of our fine-tuned checkpoint; upstream model and dataset terms continue to apply.
  • ONNX Runtime Web 1.22.0: Microsoft and contributors. MIT license.
  • OpenCV.js 4.13.0: OpenCV contributors. Apache 2.0 license. Used for contour extraction and region geometry.
  • Project code: MIT license. This license covers project-authored code only, not the dataset, pretrained model, or bundled third-party runtimes.

Uploads are processed locally in the visitor's browser. There is no image-upload endpoint in this application. Loading the application downloads its static code, runtime, and model assets.
